CREATE PROC [BNKM].[SP_CUSTOMERCOUNTRYOFCITIZENSHIP_CCD] AS
BEGIN
--------------GET DELTA FROM BUSC
WITH TMP_BNKM_CustomerCountryOfCitizenship AS 
(
SELECT 
	BCD.CUST_NBR AS CustomerId
	,BCD.CUST_NATIONALITY_CDE AS CountryId
	,BCD.CUST_DATE_MAINT  AS PeriodStartDate
	,NULL AS PeriodEndDate
	,NULL AS NationalId
	,NULL AS PassportId
	,NULL AS CitizenshipTypeId
	,BCD.CUST_NATIONALITY AS NationalityId
	,'CCD' AS SourceSystemCode
	,BCD.BNK_CODE AS FinancialInstitutionId
	,0 AS WorkFlowId
	,0 AS TaskRunId
	,BCD.INSERT_DTTM AS InsertDttm
	,BCDD.RECORD_STATUS
FROM BUSC.CCD_MCUSTOMER_DELTA BCDD
LEFT JOIN BUSC.CCD_MCUSTOMER BCD ON BCD.CUST_NBR = BCDD.CUST_NBR AND BCD.ISLATEST = 1
where BCD.CUST_NBR IS NOT NULL 
	 
UNION ALL
	
SELECT
	BCD.CUST_NBR AS CustomerId
	,BCD.CUST_NATIONALITY_CDE AS CountryId
	,BCD.CUST_DATE_MAINT  AS PeriodStartDate
	,NULL AS PeriodEndDate
	,NULL AS NationalId
	,NULL AS PassportId
	,NULL AS CitizenshipTypeId
	,BCD.CUST_NATIONALITY AS NationalityId
	,'CCD' AS SourceSystemCode
	,BCD.BNK_CODE AS FinancialInstitutionId
	,0 AS WorkFlowId
	,0 AS TaskRunId
	,BCD.INSERT_DTTM AS InsertDttm
	,BCDD.RECORD_STATUS
FROM BUSC.CCD_DCUSTOMER_DELTA BCDD
LEFT JOIN BUSC.CCD_DCUSTOMER BCD ON BCD.CUST_NBR = BCDD.CUST_NBR  AND BCD.ISLATEST = 1
where BCD.CUST_NBR IS NOT NULL
)


SELECT * INTO #TMP_BNKM_CustomerCountryOfCitizenship FROM TMP_BNKM_CustomerCountryOfCitizenship;

-------------CHECK IF THERE IS DELTA 
WITH
TMP_BNKM_CustomerCountryOfCitizenship_SRC
AS
(
SELECT
HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
CustomerId
,CountryId
,PeriodStartDate
,PeriodEndDate
,NationalId
,PassportId
,CitizenshipTypeId
,NationalityId
)) HASHROW, CustomerId, RECORD_STATUS 
FROM #TMP_BNKM_CustomerCountryOfCitizenship WHERE RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
)

,
TMP_BNKM_CustomerCountryOfCitizenship_TGT
AS
(
SELECT
HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
CustomerId
,CountryId
,PeriodStartDate
,PeriodEndDate
,NationalId
,PassportId
,CitizenshipTypeId
,NationalityId
)) HASHROW, CustomerId
FROM BNKM.CustomerCountryOfCitizenship WHERE PeriodEndDate IS NULL AND SourceSystemCode = 'CCD'	
)
,
TMP_BNKM_CustomerCountryOfCitizenship_DELTA
AS
(
SELECT	
	SRC.HASHROW AS SRC_HR
	,TGT.HASHROW AS TGT_HR
	,ISNULL(SRC.CustomerId,TGT.CustomerId) AS CustomerId
	--,ISNULL(SRC.CustomerStatusTypeId,TGT.CustomerStatusTypeId) AS CustomerStatusTypeId
	,CASE
		WHEN SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW THEN 'UPDATE'
	ELSE NULL END AS RECORD_STATUS
	
FROM TMP_BNKM_CustomerCountryOfCitizenship_SRC	SRC
FULL OUTER JOIN TMP_BNKM_CustomerCountryOfCitizenship_TGT	TGT
ON	SRC.CustomerId = TGT.CustomerId
WHERE SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW 
)

SELECT * INTO #TMP_BNKM_CustomerCountryOfCitizenship_DELTA FROM TMP_BNKM_CustomerCountryOfCitizenship_DELTA;

------UPDATE TO BNKM
UPDATE TGT 
SET
PeriodEndDate = CONVERT(DATE,CONVERT(VARCHAR,SRC.PeriodStartDate))
FROM BNKM.CustomerCountryOfCitizenship TGT
JOIN #TMP_BNKM_CustomerCountryOfCitizenship_DELTA DELTA ON DELTA.CustomerId = TGT.CustomerId  AND DELTA.RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
JOIN #TMP_BNKM_CustomerCountryOfCitizenship SRC ON SRC.CustomerId = TGT.CustomerId
WHERE TGT.PeriodEndDate IS NULL;


-------INSERT TO BNKM WITH UPDATE
INSERT INTO BNKM.CustomerCountryOfCitizenship
(
	CustomerId
	,CountryId
	,PeriodStartDate
	,PeriodEndDate
	,NationalId
	,PassportId
	,CitizenshipTypeId
	,NationalityId
	,SourceSystemCode
	,FinancialInstitutionId
	,WorkFlowId
	,TaskRunId
	,InsertDttm

)
SELECT
	SRC.CustomerId AS CustomerId
	,SRC.CountryId AS CountryId
    ,CONVERT(DATE,CONVERT(VARCHAR,PeriodStartDate)) AS PeriodStartDate
	,NULL AS PeriodEndDate
	,NULL AS NationalId
	,NULL AS PassportId
	,NULL AS CitizenshipTypeId
	,SRC.NationalityId AS NationalityId
	,'CCD' AS SourceSystemCode
	,SRC.FinancialInstitutionId AS FinancialInstitutionId
	,0 AS WorkFlowId
	,0 AS TaskRunId
	,SRC.InsertDttm AS InsertDttm
FROM #TMP_BNKM_CustomerCountryOfCitizenship SRC
JOIN #TMP_BNKM_CustomerCountryOfCitizenship_DELTA DELTA ON DELTA.CustomerId = SRC.CustomerId  AND DELTA.RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'


-------INSERT TO BNKM
INSERT INTO BNKM.CustomerCountryOfCitizenship
(
	CustomerId
	,CountryId
	,PeriodStartDate
	,PeriodEndDate
	,NationalId
	,PassportId
	,CitizenshipTypeId
	,NationalityId
	,SourceSystemCode
	,FinancialInstitutionId
	,WorkFlowId
	,TaskRunId
	,InsertDttm

)
SELECT
    CustomerId AS CustomerId
	,CountryId AS CountryId
    ,CONVERT(DATE,CONVERT(VARCHAR,PeriodStartDate)) AS PeriodStartDate
	,NULL AS PeriodEndDate
	,NULL AS NationalId
	,NULL AS PassportId
	,NULL AS CitizenshipTypeId
	,NationalityId AS NationalityId
	,'CCD' AS SourceSystemCode
	,FinancialInstitutionId AS FinancialInstitutionId
	,0 AS WorkFlowId
	,0 AS TaskRunId
	,InsertDttm AS InsertDttm
FROM #TMP_BNKM_CustomerCountryOfCitizenship
WHERE RECORD_STATUS IN ('INSERT');


DROP TABLE #TMP_BNKM_CustomerCountryOfCitizenship;
DROP TABLE #TMP_BNKM_CustomerCountryOfCitizenship_DELTA;

END
GO
